brief:
Israeli drone fire struck an area near Abu Sharkh roundabout in northern Gaza on Tuesday, the Shehab Wire reported. Local sources said the strike by an Israeli unmanned aircraft targeted the vicinity of the roundabout, wounding a number of residents in the incident.

The roundabout, located in the northern section of the Gaza Strip, has been a site of activity and civilian movement. The strike marks the latest in a series of Israeli aerial operations in the territory. Specifics regarding the exact number of those wounded and the extent of their injuries were not immediately disclosed by local authorities or medical facilities responding to the incident.
